name: North Dakota

agency.name: North Dakota Industrial Commission, Department of Mineral Resources, Oil and Gas Division

form.name: Application for Permit to Drill, Form 1 (vertical or directional) and Form 1H (horizontal)
form.number: SFN 4615 (10-2014) for Form 1; SFN 54269 (12-2016) for Form 1H
form.notes: Read both blank PDFs (text extracted with pdftotext), including the instruction pages (15 numbered rules for Form 1H). The agency forms page lists them as filed online in NorthSTAR (older form text still mentions an ePermit user ID); the PDFs read may be older than the online screens, and the Type of Work and Type of Well choices are drop-down lists not visible in the text. Injection and disposal wells use Form 14 (Application for Injection) through the same permit process, not read. Form 1H adds lateral, KOP, azimuth and survey boxes. Companion forms not read: Form 14, Form 4 sundry notices, Form 6 completion report. The Form 1H PDF is at the forms folder under the name form1H.PDF.

api_number.n: Wells layer fields api_no and api; also in the state-use box of Form 1/1H

permit_number.n: Layer field fileno (NDIC file number); the form's state-use box is one 'Permit and File Number'

well_name.n: Layer field well_name; Form 1 has Well Name and Well Number boxes

lease_name.n: Form 1/1H have no lease or unit name box (well name and number only)

operator_id.n: Form 1 asks operator name only; no operator number seen in any file read

operator_type.n: Form 1 does not ask; entity details sit on the separate Form 2 organization report

bond.n: Instruction 5: bond must accompany or already be on file; no bond box; bond view in NorthSTAR not checked

district.n: Not on the form or in the layers read; a separate inspector-areas polygon layer exists

field_pool.n: Layer field field_name; Field and Pool boxes are in the form's state-use area

surface_latlon.n: Layer fields latitude, longitude; form asks wellhead lat/long and NAD reference

surface_plss.n: Layer fields qq, sec, twp, rng, feet_ns, fnsl, feet_ew, fewl

bottom_hole_loc.n: Form 1 'Proposed Bottom Hole Location' and Form 1H footages; Wells layer holds the surface point only

lateral_path.n: Horizontal_Well_Bore polylines, 'derived from surveys' (as drilled), keyed by fileno; Form 1H asks for the plan

elevation.n: Daily report prints 'xxxx GROUND'; not a layer field; form asks ground elevation

surface_owner.n: Form 1 'Name of Surface Owner or Tenant' plus dwelling-notice boxes; not published

well_type.n: Layer field well_type (codes such as ST, OG, SWD, WI, GI, AGD); form asks Type of Well

work_type.n: Daily report headings (approved, recompletion, renewal, modification); no layer field; Form 1 has a Type of Work box

well_direction.n: Choice of Form 1 (vertical or directional) or Form 1H (horizontal); no direction field in the layers read

proposed_depth_md.n: Form 1 Estimated Total Depth (Feet MD); Form 1H longstring and lateral depths; layer 'td' not verified as proposed or MD

lateral_length.n: Shape__Length of the survey-derived Horizontal_Well_Bore line (as drilled, Web Mercator units); form: KOP, lateral depth

target_formation.n: Form 1 'Objective Horizons'; the spacing-units layer names a formation per unit, not per well

formation_tops.n: Boxes for Pierre Shale, Dakota Sand, base of last salt; instruction 9 asks estimated geologic tops

casing_program.n: Proposed surface and longstring casing: size, weight, depth

cement_program.n: Cement volume (sacks) and cement top; instruction 9 asks the cementing plan

pressure_control.n: No BOP or pressure-control box or attachment on Form 1/1H or its 15 instructions

h2s.n: No H2S box or attachment on Form 1/1H

pit_waste.n: Instruction 7: pad layout with cut and fill and the proposed cuttings pit location

water.n: No water source or volume box; only a note that the surface hole is drilled with fresh water

fracture_plan.n: Instruction 11/12: 'general completion technique' must accompany the application

spacing_unit.n: DrillingSpacingUnits layer (formation, caseno, orderno, dssize, dstype; no well id); form asks acres, setback, order

spacing_exception.n: Daily report adds 'location outside of spacing unit' or 'drill-back outside of spacing unit' to an entry; no data field

mineral_owner.n: Form 1/1H ask for the surface owner or tenant only

fee.n: $100 permit fee (instructions 13/14); the agency now collects fees by an online payment service

notice_hearing.n: Dwelling-notice boxes (1,320 ft and 500 ft); hearing cases are a separate docket layer and pages not read

date_received.n: Form has a signature date only; no receipt date seen in any file or report read

date_approved.n: The daily report's date (entries are under PERMITS APPROVED); form's state-use 'Date Approved'; not in the layers

date_expires.n: Instruction 14/15: lapses after one year unless drilling below surface casing; layer gives only a day-range bucket

spud_date.n: Layer field spud_date (37,029 of 44,030 wells have one)

completion_date.n: Not in the free layers; scout tickets (paid subscription) are described as holding completion data

status.n: Layer field status (A, PA, DRY, PNC, LOC, DRL, Confidential and others)

plat_image.n: Certified surveyor's plat required; scanned well files are a paid-subscription item

form_image.n: Filed application sits in scanned well files, a paid-subscription item

completion_report.n: Form 6 is a separate filing; scanned well files are paid-subscription items

logs.n: Digital and image logs are described on a paid-subscription page; free access not verified

production_link.n: Monthly production report PDFs from 2003 and by-well volumes in paid tables; well-level content of free PDFs unchecked

grade_reason: The only free bulk or API source (the Wells map layer, 44,030 wells) has a spud date, well type and status but no approval date or work type, so by the grading rule it measures spuds. The approval dates exist only in the free Daily Activity Report text PDFs (one per business day since 1997, well-level, with section headings that give the activity type) and in the monthly statistics PDF (aggregate). Those make approvals countable, but from PDFs, which the rubric rates C; the well index Excel file is paid.
producer_plan: Approvals and activity types: read the Daily Activity Report PDFs (one per business day, a per-year folder, file name drMMDDYY.pdf, about 150 KB, text-based; pdftotext -layout worked on two 2026 reports). Treat the report date as the approval day (assumption: not checked against the filing system). Each entry starts '#fileno - OPERATOR, well name, location, county...'. Count entries by heading: PERMITS APPROVED = new drill; PERMITTED FOR RECOMPLETION = recomplete; PERMIT MODIFICATION (surface hole location, spacing unit change) = amend; PERMIT RENEWALS, PERMIT CANCELLATIONS, CHANGE OF OPERATOR and RELEASED FROM CONFIDENTIAL STATUS = other (never count renewals as new). Injection and disposal permits have no heading of their own: join the file number to the Wells layer well_type (SWD, WI, GI and similar) or read SWD in the well name; whether such permits appear under PERMITS APPROVED was not verified. Only two reports were read, so check the headings against a sample from each year before trusting a long history; be polite (a pause between files, a few hundred files a night at most). Cross-check each month against the Monthly Statistical Update PDF for the year (permits Dev, Ext, WC and spuds): Aug 2026 shows 84 permits and 91 spuds. Spuds and drilling status: query the Wells layer (about 23 pages of 2,000 rows, or a spud_date range filter); Aug 2026 gave 90 spud-dated wells against 91 in the statistics. Fallback for approvals if the PDFs become unreadable: permit file numbers rise in sequence (#43197 on Aug 10, 2026; #43440 on Oct 29, 2026), so the Wells layer's fileno could place permits in time roughly, but the numbers are not approval dates and the 90xxx and 99xxx series are not sequential. Caveats: confidential wells are shown with limited detail; the Wells layer is a current snapshot, not a history of statuses.
privacy_notes: The layers and daily reports name operators (companies) and wells; I saw no individual's name in the fields read, but an operator can be an individual or carry a 'DBA' name, so apply the project's name rule before publishing. The blank forms ask for operator telephone and e-mail, surface-owner names and addresses; those are filed data, not published in the layers or reports I read. Daily reports end with an agency contact line (not copied).
